capabilities: Read EPUB books with adjustable layout, typography, themes and a bookshelf with progress
Highlight, underline and comment on passages with CFI-anchored, searchable annotations
Ask AI to explain, translate or comment on selected text via OpenAI-compatible providers
Show paragraph translations embedded under original text and popup dictionary lookups
Read books aloud sentence-by-sentence with system or cloud TTS voices
extras: Manual installation from GitHub releases; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a detailed privacy note listing exactly which network requests each feature makes, and explains API-key storage in the system keychain (Obsidian 1.11.4+) versus plaintext data.json. Documents a CSP workaround for duokan-style classic-book EPUBs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read EPUB books or annotate them alongside notes.
